name: GEOS
what_it_does: C/C++ geometry engine for predicates, overlays, buffers and validity checks, ported from JTS.
notes: Underpins Shapely, PostGIS, QGIS and GDAL geometry ops.

name: JTS Topology Suite
what_it_does: Reference Java library for 2D planar geometry operations, spatial predicates and indexing.
notes: JVM dependency; reference semantics for Simple Features ops.

name: NetTopologySuite
what_it_does: .NET port of JTS providing geometry types, operations and IO.

name: JSTS
what_it_does: JavaScript port of JTS for geometry predicates and overlay operations in browsers and Node.
notes: Robust overlays in a JS frontend.

name: Turf.js
what_it_does: Modular JavaScript toolkit for geospatial analysis on GeoJSON such as buffers, distances and aggregation.
notes: Lightweight analysis in a web UI or Node tool server.

name: Shapely
what_it_does: Python library exposing GEOS geometry objects and vectorized operations on NumPy arrays.
notes: Default geometry layer for agent-written Python.

name: Boost.Geometry
what_it_does: Header-only C++ library of geometry algorithms, spatial indexes (R-tree) and coordinate systems.

name: CGAL
what_it_does: Computational geometry library with exact predicates, triangulations, meshes and polygon operations.
notes: GPL for most packages; commercial licence via GeometryFactory.

name: SFCGAL
what_it_does: Wrapper around CGAL adding ISO 19107 3D geometry operations and used by PostGIS for 3D functions.

name: geo (GeoRust)
what_it_does: Rust crate of geometry types and algorithms such as area, simplification, boolean ops and distance.
notes: Core for a Rust-based app like RustGIS.

name: geo-types (GeoRust)
what_it_does: Shared Rust geometry primitive types used as the interchange layer across GeoRust crates.
notes: Common type layer for Rust ecosystem.

name: geos (Rust bindings)
what_it_does: Rust bindings to the GEOS C API.
notes: Gives Rust access to GEOS semantics.

name: i_overlay
what_it_does: Rust polygon boolean operations library, used as the backend for geo's boolean ops.
notes: Fast robust overlay in pure Rust.

name: Clipper2
what_it_does: Polygon clipping and offsetting library for integer and float coordinates.

name: polygon-clipping
what_it_does: JavaScript library for polygon union, intersection, difference and XOR on GeoJSON-like coordinates.
notes: Used by Turf for boolean ops.

name: GeographicLib
language: C++ (ports in C, Java, JS, Python, others)
what_it_does: Accurate geodesic, geoid, magnetic and projection computations on the ellipsoid.

name: geographiclib (Python)
what_it_does: Pure Python implementation of GeographicLib geodesic routines.

name: S2 Geometry
what_it_does: Spherical geometry library with a hierarchical cell decomposition for indexing and region covering.

name: s2geography
what_it_does: C++ layer on S2 providing Simple Features-style geography operations, used by R s2 and DuckDB.

name: s2 (R package)
what_it_does: R bindings to S2 used by sf for spherical geometry on geographic coordinates.

name: Spherely
what_it_does: Python library for spherical geometry built on s2geography, a Shapely-like API on the sphere.

name: SpatiaLite (libspatialite)
what_it_does: SQLite extension library adding spatial SQL functions, geometry types and spatial indexes.
notes: Lets an embedded SQLite do spatial SQL.

name: RTTOPO (librttopo)
what_it_does: Topology and geometry library derived from PostGIS liblwgeom, used by SpatiaLite.

name: Esri Geometry API for Java
what_it_does: Esri's open Java geometry library supporting relational operations, used by Hive/Spark spatial tools.
notes: Older JVM engine; still in GIS Tools for Hadoop.

name: libpostgis / liblwgeom
what_it_does: PostGIS's internal lightweight geometry library for serialization and geometry functions.
notes: Not a standalone product; embedded in PostGIS.

name: CGAL Python bindings (cgal-swig-bindings)
what_it_does: SWIG-based Python bindings for selected CGAL packages.

name: Delaunator
what_it_does: Fast 2D Delaunay triangulation library, with ports in Rust, C++ and other languages.

name: earcut
what_it_does: Polygon triangulation library used for rendering polygons on GPUs.
notes: Used by most WebGL map renderers.

name: robust-predicates
what_it_does: Port of Shewchuk's robust geometric predicates for exact orientation and in-circle tests.

name: geoarrow-rs / geoarrow (Rust)
what_it_does: Rust implementation of GeoArrow arrays with geometry ops and Python/JS bindings.
notes: Columnar geometry processing for big data.

name: PROJ
what_it_does: Coordinate transformation library and CLI tools covering projections, datum shifts and the EPSG database.

name: pyproj
what_it_does: Python interface to PROJ for CRS definitions, transformations and geodesic calculations.

name: proj (GeoRust)
what_it_does: Rust bindings to PROJ for coordinate transformation.

name: proj4rs
what_it_does: Pure Rust port of proj4js projection logic, usable in WebAssembly.

name: Proj4js
what_it_does: JavaScript library to transform coordinates between projections defined by PROJ strings or WKT.

name: PROJ.4 Java / Proj4J
what_it_does: Java port of PROJ.4 projection routines maintained under LocationTech.

name: Apache SIS
what_it_does: Java library implementing OGC/ISO standards for CRS, metadata and data stores.

name: ProjNet (ProjNET4GeoAPI)
what_it_does: .NET library for coordinate system conversions and transformations.

name: EPSG Geodetic Parameter Dataset
license: Proprietary (free use under EPSG terms of use)
what_it_does: Authoritative registry of coordinate reference systems, datums and transformations maintained by IOGP.
notes: Source of CRS codes embedded in PROJ.

name: PROJ-data
what_it_does: Collection of datum grids (geoid models, NTv2 shift grids) used by PROJ for accurate transformations.
notes: Needed offline for accurate datum shifts.

name: spatialreference.org
what_it_does: Website listing CRS definitions in WKT, PROJ and other formats, now generated from PROJ.

name: epsg.io
what_it_does: Website and API for searching CRS definitions and transforming coordinates, run by MapTiler.
notes: Quick CRS lookup; API needs key.

name: WKT-CRS (ISO 19162)
what_it_does: Well-known text encoding for describing coordinate reference systems and transformations.
notes: Preferred CRS interchange over PROJ strings.

name: PROJJSON
what_it_does: JSON encoding of CRS definitions mirroring WKT2, used by GeoParquet and PROJ.

name: Geodesy (Rust)
what_it_does: Experimental Rust platform for geodetic transformations designed as a PROJ successor experiment.

name: GDAL
what_it_does: Translator library and CLI tools reading and writing hundreds of raster and vector formats.
notes: Backbone of format support; agent can call gdal CLI.

name: OGR (GDAL vector)
what_it_does: Vector part of GDAL providing drivers, SQL dialects and ogr2ogr conversion.

name: GDAL Python bindings (osgeo)
what_it_does: Official SWIG Python bindings for GDAL/OGR/OSR.

name: gdal (GeoRust)
what_it_does: Rust bindings to GDAL for raster and vector IO.
notes: Brings GDAL formats to a Rust app.

name: Rasterio
what_it_does: Pythonic raster IO built on GDAL with NumPy arrays and windowed reads.
notes: Standard raster IO for Python agents.

name: Fiona
what_it_does: Pythonic vector IO built on GDAL/OGR for reading and writing features.
notes: Largely superseded by pyogrio in GeoPandas.

name: pyogrio
what_it_does: Fast vectorized vector IO for GeoPandas using GDAL with Arrow support.

name: rioxarray
what_it_does: Rasterio-powered extension adding CRS and geospatial IO to xarray.

name: GeoTools
what_it_does: Java toolkit implementing OGC standards with data stores, rendering and CRS support.

name: geozero
what_it_does: Rust zero-copy reading and writing of many geo formats via a streaming processor API.

name: geojson (GeoRust)
what_it_does: Rust crate for parsing and serialising GeoJSON.

name: wkt (GeoRust)
what_it_does: Rust crate for reading and writing Well-Known Text geometries.

name: shapefile (Rust)
what_it_does: Pure Rust reader and writer for ESRI Shapefiles.

name: tiff / geotiff (Rust)
what_it_does: Rust crates for decoding TIFF images and reading GeoTIFF georeferencing tags.
notes: Pure Rust GeoTIFF reading, still maturing.

name: async-tiff
what_it_does: Asynchronous TIFF/COG reader for Rust and Python built on object-store.
notes: Fast COG reads from cloud storage.

name: flatgeobuf (Rust crate)
what_it_does: Rust implementation of FlatGeobuf reading/writing including HTTP range reads.
notes: Part of the multi-language FlatGeobuf repo.

name: las-rs
what_it_does: Pure Rust reader and writer for LAS point clouds.

name: libosmium
what_it_does: Libosmium is a fast C++ library for processing OpenStreetMap data files, with the osmium CLI.

name: PyOsmium
what_it_does: Python bindings for libosmium to process OSM files and change streams.

name: libgeotiff
what_it_does: Library and tools (listgeo, geotifcp) for reading and writing GeoTIFF georeferencing tags.

name: libtiff
what_it_does: Reference library for reading and writing TIFF images underlying GeoTIFF.

name: MDAL
what_it_does: Mesh data abstraction library reading 2D/3D unstructured meshes (UGRID, 2DM, SELAFIN, etc.).

name: PDAL
what_it_does: Point cloud translation and processing library with JSON pipelines and CLI.

name: LAStools / LASlib
what_it_does: Point cloud toolset with open LASlib IO and commercially licensed processing tools.

name: LASzip
what_it_does: Lossless compression library for LAS point clouds producing LAZ files.

name: laspy
what_it_does: Python library for reading and writing LAS/LAZ point clouds as NumPy arrays.
notes: Simple point cloud IO in Python.

name: NetCDF-C / netCDF4-python
what_it_does: Unidata reference libraries for reading and writing netCDF files.

name: HDF5 library
what_it_does: Reference library for the HDF5 hierarchical data format.
notes: Underlies NetCDF4 and many EO products.

name: h5py
what_it_does: Python interface to HDF5 files using NumPy arrays.

name: zarr-python
what_it_does: Python implementation of the Zarr chunked, compressed N-dimensional array format.

name: xarray
what_it_does: Labelled N-dimensional array library widely used for NetCDF, Zarr and gridded geodata.

name: OWSLib
what_it_does: Python client for OGC web services such as WMS, WFS, WCS, CSW and OGC API.

name: libkml
what_it_does: Google's C++ reference library for parsing and writing KML.

name: simplekml
what_it_does: Python package for generating KML files.

name: ezdxf
what_it_does: Python library for creating and editing DXF CAD drawings.

name: LibreDWG
what_it_does: GNU library for reading and writing DWG files.

name: ODA Drawings SDK (Teigha)
what_it_does: Commercial SDK from Open Design Alliance for reading and writing DWG/DGN files.
notes: Used by GDAL DWG/DGNv8 drivers; paid membership.

name: Esri File Geodatabase API
what_it_does: Esri's free closed-source C++ API for reading and writing File Geodatabases.

name: GDAL OpenFileGDB driver
what_it_does: Open-source GDAL driver reading and writing Esri File Geodatabases without the Esri SDK.

name: pyshp
what_it_does: Pure Python reader and writer for ESRI Shapefiles.

name: shapefile.js / shpjs
what_it_does: JavaScript library that converts zipped Shapefiles to GeoJSON in the browser.

name: geotiff.js
what_it_does: JavaScript parser for TIFF/GeoTIFF and COG with HTTP range reads.

name: loaders.gl
what_it_does: Framework-agnostic loaders for many geospatial and 3D formats from the vis.gl suite.

name: GeoArrow (Python geoarrow-pyarrow etc.)
what_it_does: Python and C implementations of GeoArrow geometry arrays (geoarrow-c, geoarrow-pyarrow).

name: terra / sf / stars (R)
what_it_does: Core R packages for vector (sf), raster (terra) and datacube (stars) spatial data built on GDAL/GEOS/PROJ.

name: GeoPandas
what_it_does: Extends pandas with geometry columns and spatial operations for vector data.

name: GDAL JS (gdal3.js)
what_it_does: WebAssembly build of GDAL for format conversion in browsers and Node.
notes: GDAL in a webview without native install.

name: Esri Projection Engine / ArcObjects SDK
what_it_does: Esri's proprietary projection and geometry engines embedded in ArcGIS SDKs.

name: Safe FME Engine
what_it_does: Commercial data integration engine translating hundreds of GIS, CAD and database formats.
notes: Commercial alternative to GDAL for exotic formats.

name: libspatialindex
what_it_does: C++ library implementing R-tree, MVR-tree and TPR-tree spatial indexes.

name: Rtree (Python)
what_it_does: Python ctypes wrapper of libspatialindex for R-tree queries.

name: rstar
what_it_does: Rust R*-tree implementation for spatial queries and nearest neighbours.

name: RBush
what_it_does: High-performance JavaScript R-tree for 2D points and rectangles.

name: Flatbush
what_it_does: Static packed Hilbert R-tree for very fast indexing of 2D data in JS.

name: KDBush
what_it_does: Static KD-tree index for 2D points in JavaScript.

name: nanoflann
what_it_does: Header-only C++ KD-tree library for nearest-neighbour search in point clouds.

name: H3
language: C (bindings in Python, JS, Java, Go, R, others)
what_it_does: Hexagonal hierarchical global grid system from Uber for indexing and aggregating locations.
notes: Widely used for binning; DuckDB/PostGIS extensions.

name: h3-py
what_it_does: Official Python bindings for H3.

name: h3-js
what_it_does: Official JavaScript bindings for H3.

name: h3o
what_it_does: Pure Rust implementation of the H3 grid system.
notes: H3 without C bindings in Rust.

name: S2 cells
what_it_does: Hierarchical quadrilateral cells on the sphere defined by S2, addressed by 64-bit cell IDs.

name: Geohash
what_it_does: Base-32 string encoding of latitude/longitude into a Z-order grid for prefix-based proximity.

name: Bing Maps Tile System (quadkeys)

name: mercantile

name: morecantile
what_it_does: Python implementation of OGC TileMatrixSet for arbitrary CRS tiling.

name: OGC Two Dimensional Tile Matrix Set
what_it_does: OGC standard defining tile grids and tile matrix sets for any CRS.

name: Open Location Code (Plus Codes)
language: Multiple (C, Java, JS, Python, Go, Rust)
what_it_does: Open grid-based short code for any location, with reference libraries in many languages.

name: what3words
what_it_does: Commercial system assigning three-word addresses to 3 m squares worldwide via API and SDKs.
notes: Licensed API; cannot be computed offline freely.

name: Maidenhead Locator System
what_it_does: Amateur radio grid square locator encoding latitude/longitude in alternating letter/digit pairs.

name: MGRS / USNG
what_it_does: Military and US national grid reference systems based on UTM zones and 100 km squares.
notes: Supported by GeographicLib and PROJ tools.

name: mgrs (JS)
what_it_does: JavaScript conversion between MGRS and latitude/longitude, part of proj4js org.

name: OGC DGGS Abstract Specification
what_it_does: OGC abstract specification (ISO 19170-1) defining discrete global grid systems.

name: OGC API - DGGS
what_it_does: OGC API standard for retrieving data organised by discrete global grid zones.
notes: Emerging web API for DGGS data.

name: DGGRID
what_it_does: Command-line tool for generating and working with icosahedral discrete global grids (ISEA, FULLER).
notes: AGPL; wrapped by dggridR and dggrid4py.

name: dggridR
what_it_does: R package wrapping DGGRID for binning data into equal-area hexagonal grids.

name: dggrid4py
what_it_does: Python wrapper that drives the DGGRID executable and returns GeoPandas outputs.

name: A5
what_it_does: Pentagonal equal-area discrete global grid system with JS, Rust and Python implementations.

name: OpenEAGGR
what_it_does: Open equal-area global grid library supporting ISEA hexagonal and triangular cells.

name: rHEALPix / rhealpixdggs
what_it_does: Python implementation of the rHEALPix equal-area discrete global grid system.

name: HEALPix
what_it_does: Equal-area hierarchical pixelisation of the sphere from astronomy, usable for global geodata.

name: vgrid
what_it_does: Python toolkit converting between many DGGS and geocode systems (H3, S2, A5, rHEALPix, Geohash, etc.).

name: Mapcode
what_it_does: Mapcode system for short location codes, open-sourced by its foundation with libraries in several languages.

name: Placekey
what_it_does: Universal place identifier combining address encoding with an H3-based location part.
notes: POI join key; API needs key.

name: GeoTIFF
what_it_does: TIFF image extended with tags describing georeferencing and CRS.

name: Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF (COG)
what_it_does: GeoTIFF layout with internal tiling and overviews enabling efficient HTTP range reads.

name: rio-cogeo
what_it_does: Rasterio plugin to create and validate Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs.

name: NetCDF
what_it_does: Self-describing format for multidimensional scientific arrays, common for climate and ocean data.

name: CF Conventions
what_it_does: Climate and Forecast metadata conventions for NetCDF describing coordinates, units and grids.

name: HDF5
what_it_does: Hierarchical binary container for large scientific datasets used by many satellite products.

name: HDF4 / HDF-EOS
what_it_does: Older HDF format and NASA EOS profile used by legacy MODIS and other satellite products.

name: Zarr
what_it_does: Chunked, compressed N-dimensional array storage format designed for cloud object stores.

name: GeoZarr
what_it_does: Draft OGC specification adding geospatial conventions (CRS, multiscales) to Zarr.
notes: Still in draft; ESA EOPF adopting.

name: Kerchunk / VirtualiZarr
what_it_does: Python tools that build virtual Zarr references over existing NetCDF/HDF5/GRIB files.

name: GRIB / GRIB2
what_it_does: WMO binary format for gridded meteorological data such as forecasts.

name: ecCodes
what_it_does: ECMWF library and tools for decoding and encoding GRIB and BUFR.

name: JPEG 2000 / GMLJP2
what_it_does: Wavelet-compressed image format with embedded GML georeferencing, used by Sentinel-2.

name: OpenJPEG
what_it_does: Open-source JPEG 2000 codec used by GDAL's JP2 driver.

name: MrSID
what_it_does: Extensis wavelet-compressed raster format for large imagery and LiDAR, read via the MrSID SDK.

name: ECW
what_it_does: Hexagon wavelet-compressed imagery format read via the ERDAS ECW/JP2 SDK.

name: Esri Grid (ArcInfo binary grid)
what_it_does: Esri's legacy directory-based binary raster format.

name: Esri ASCII Grid (AAIGrid)
what_it_does: Plain-text raster grid with header giving extent and cell size.

name: Esri CRF / MRF
what_it_does: Meta Raster Format (NASA/Esri, open) and Esri's Cloud Raster Format for tiled cloud rasters.

name: ERDAS IMAGINE (.img)

name: ENVI raster format

name: Virtual Raster (VRT)
what_it_does: GDAL XML format that mosaics, subsets or transforms other rasters without copying data.

name: SAFE (Sentinel)
what_it_does: ESA product packaging format containing manifests and imagery for Sentinel missions.

name: DTED
what_it_does: Military digital terrain elevation data format in fixed tiles.

name: USGS DEM / SDTS
what_it_does: Legacy USGS elevation and transfer standards still found in archives.

name: BAG (Bathymetric Attributed Grid)
what_it_does: HDF5-based format for gridded bathymetry with uncertainty from ONS-WG.

name: Terrain-RGB / Terrarium
what_it_does: Encodings that pack elevation values into PNG/WebP RGB tiles for web maps.

name: STAC
what_it_does: SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog JSON specification describing geospatial assets for search.

name: Shapefile
what_it_does: Esri's multi-file vector format (.shp/.shx/.dbf/.prj) still ubiquitous for exchange.

name: File Geodatabase
what_it_does: Esri's folder-based geodatabase format for vector, raster and topology in ArcGIS.

name: Mobile Geodatabase
what_it_does: Esri SQLite-based single-file geodatabase used by ArcGIS Pro and Runtime.

name: Esri Personal Geodatabase (.mdb)
what_it_does: Legacy Esri geodatabase stored in Microsoft Access files.

name: Esri JSON
what_it_does: JSON geometry and feature encoding used by ArcGIS REST services.

name: GeoPackage
what_it_does: SQLite-based OGC container for vector features, tile pyramids and attributes in one file.

name: GeoJSON
what_it_does: JSON encoding of features and geometries in WGS84 coordinates.

name: GeoJSONSeq / newline-delimited GeoJSON
what_it_does: Sequence of GeoJSON texts separated by record separators or newlines for streaming.

name: TopoJSON
what_it_does: JSON extension of GeoJSON that encodes shared topology arcs to shrink file size.

name: FlatGeobuf

name: GeoParquet

name: GeoArrow
